title: SEEK HIS PATH
DIVINE GUIDANCE
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: peaceful river winding through misty alpine valley at dawn
quiet mountain pass in soft morning light
serene pine forest with gentle morning fog
calm alpine lake reflecting the morning sky
distant mountain peaks under quiet clouds
tranquil valley bathed in golden early light

scenes.a: Bring the decision currently before you into the quiet presence of the Lord.
Lord God, we come before Your throne asking for heavenly wisdom and discernment for every step we take today.
Show me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.
Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
Quiet our restless thoughts, Father, and give us the patience to wait upon Your perfect timing and unfailing grace.
Guide our feet along Your righteous path, and let Your steadfast love direct our hearts today. Amen.
